title: Cost accounting part 1: tag every resource with anthus:app, anthus:account, anthus:deployment and fail CI on an untagged one
description:
Outcome: The Prospectus package @anthus/cost-accounting (vendored tarball; applyCostTags and assertCostTags, merged in Prospectus kanbus-543ced) is applied in amplify/site-backend.ts and tags every taggable resource from the site config (account UUID and deployment id; 'shared' on a shared-mode stack); a synth test fails on a taggable resource without anthus:app and anthus:account. Token reporting is part 2, when the Prospectus sender library is ready. Size: one agent session. Worktree Papyrus-worktrees/ (beside the Papyrus checkout) cost-tags, branch feature/<this issue id>-cost-tags from origin/develop (spikes: branch spike/<this issue id>-cost-tags, sandbox only, no PR needed beyond notes).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/site-backend.ts, amplify/site-backend-config.ts (accountId, deploymentId), new scripts/test-cost-tags.ts.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/cost-accounting-reports.feature):
Scenario: An untagged resource fails CI
    Given a stack with a table missing anthus:account
    When the synth test runs
    Then it fails naming the resource

Dependencies: blocked by nothing. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: npm run typecheck; npx tsx scripts/test-cost-tags.ts; npm test.
Rollout: Merge to develop by PR when green (not a release; the newsroom automation session owns releases). Record branch, PR and verification on this issue.
Risk and mitigation: Low; scoped to one session.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
